text:
sarah: Bringing up scorpion13b (FP16->ONNX-int8) on canary. Getting intermittent OOMs at seq=80, batch=4 and ~2x latency vs fp16 baseline. Anyone seen this? Attaching run logs.
ajay: Which kernel / config? Are you running prefetch + windowed batching?
sarah: ONNX Runtime v1.15, perf-opt flags: --use_fast_kernels true, pipelined-kv=enabled. Prefetch on. I'll paste tail of log: 
```
[E][inference] alloc failed: cudaMalloc 0x7ff... size=524288000
[W] KV cache mem use spike: 3.2GB -> 6.8GB
Latency p95: 220ms -> 480ms
```
maria: OOMs look like KV cache duplication. Did you run with per-request kv_copy=false? default changed in recent runtime.
sarah: I was using runtime default. Changing kv_copy=false in config now. Re-running quick smoke.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 6177778890: scorpion13b-int8 v1 rolled to 5% traffic :eyes:
ajay: Also try batcher window 25ms -> 10ms and max_new_tokens default from 256 -> 128 for the canary. Should reduce KV growth.
sarah: Quick results: with kv_copy=false + max_new_tokens=128 + window=10ms batch=4 -> OOM gone, latency p95 260ms. Still higher than target 180ms.
leo: What's CPU vs GPU breakdown? Could be ONNX graph fusion regressing. Can you run nvprof/metrics for matmul kernels?
sarah: Attached nvprof snippet:
```
GPU time matmul_gemm: 42%  total 120ms
softmax kernel: 30%  total 86ms
memory copies spiked at step 1
```
maria: If matmul is the hotspot, try switching to cuBLAS GEMM params or fallback to CUTLASS optimized kernel. There's a flag runtime.kernel_policy=auto|cutlass|cublas.
ajay: Also run a quick eval comparing fp16 baseline on same sequence length with same batch. If int8 increases matmul kernels due to reorder, need to change quant packing.
sarah: Ran comparison: fp16 p95 190ms, int8 p95 260ms. CPU tokenization negligible. So int8 path has extra fusing overhead + additional memcpy.
maria: Propose: 1) patch runtime to set kernel_policy=cutlass for scorpion13b int8, 2) keep kv_copy=false, 3) lower default max_new_tokens to 128 for this model. We can A/B test.
ajay: Agreed. Also add guard in model metadata to set prefetch=false when batch>2 for sequences>64; prevents duplicate fetch.
sarah: I'll open a PR with the kernel_policy toggle + model metadata change. Will run 4-hour canary.
deploy-bot: PR 3245 opened by sarah: draft -> includes kernel_policy toggle and model_defaults.json change.
leo: If canary still shows 260ms after cutlass, we should instrument KV allocations to check for fragmentation. Use env DEBUG_MEM_STATS=1.
sarah: Sounds good. Timeline: smoke now, canary in 30m, 4h check, then roll to 50% if stable. Will post results.
ajay: :thumbsup: keep an eye on quality; int8 had small 0.8% EM delta in earlier evals. ping diana for eval baseline.
diana_research: I'll run evals on the new canary prompts overnight. If quality delta >1% we revert regardless of perf.
sarah: Update 30m: canary with kernel_policy=cutlass reduced p95 to 195ms, no OOMs. dumping mem stats now.
sarah: DEBUG_MEM_STATS:
```
active: 5.1GB
peak: 5.5GB
fragments: 12
largest_free: 120MB
```
Looks clean.
ajay: Nice. Next: We should add a model-specific rollout note to console: 'scorpion13b-int8 defaults: max_new_tokens=128, kv_copy=false, kernel_policy=cutlass'.
sarah: Will add console note + change in model_defaults.json + ship.
